svg.title: 10 · Observability and Operations Architecture
svg.desc: Metrics path: services, Kafka, MySQL and host expose metrics that Prometheus scrapes every 10 seconds directly or through exporters; Grafana visualises them. Audit path: every service publishes audit events to topic-event-audit; the reporting events processor stores them in MongoDB for the reporting API and Finance Portal. Health checks, container logs, Kafka UIs and TTK reports complete the operational view. Alerting, log aggregation, a tracing backend and Kubernetes probes are not present.
svg.text: The metrics, audit, health and logging paths this repository actually provides, what was verified, and what is missing

Prometheus targets are named for the perf stack (ml-core-*-N)

central services, central services characterisation, ML API adapter, quoting, k6, node

Started with --no-deps they run: Prometheus ready on :9090, Grafana healthy on

traceparent carried in headers and events

C · HEALTH, LOGS AND OPERATIONAL TOOLING
17 Compose health checks; central-settlement's uses the wrong port, so it shows unhealthy
HTML reports per run (reports/) and history in MongoDB ttk
Kafka console consumer with print.timestamp; MySQL queries on transferStateChange; audit
events by transferId (see the learning guide M7)
D · NOT PRESENT IN THIS REPOSITORY
Alertmanager service and alert rules are commented out
No Loki, ELK or similar; Event SDK log output off
No Jaeger, Tempo or OpenTelemetry collector; trace events off
Readiness and liveness probes live in the external Helm charts, not here
No service-level objectives, runbooks or escalation defined
Sources: docker-compose-monitoring.yml, docker/prometheus/, docker/grafana/provisioning/, docker/event_sdk/config.json, compose health checks, lab runs. Target observability stack: 03b.
